'''Super-hyperroutes''', also known as '''super-hyperlanes''', were [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] that served as the primary routes of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Such routes were the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. Many thousands of smaller routes and spurs trailed off from these five.
